title: HLC node_id not persisted; changes on restart, may collide across peers
description: transit/main.rs:224-235: node_id derived from first 8 bytes of libp2p peer_id at startup. Not persisted to disk. On restart, if peer_id is regenerated, the node_id changes — HLC timestamps from before and after restart are not comparable. Two peers sharing the same first 8 bytes of peer_id have identical node_ids, breaking the uniqueness invariant the HLC relies on for ordering. Fix: persist node_id on first startup; derive via SHA-256 of the stable peer public key (deterministic and unique).
